summary: Post-market 2026-11-04. Read this as a session snapshot, not a closing print: every file is stamped 20:37Z, which is 15:37 ET and 23 minutes before the 16:00 bell, so the US prices are only where the tape stood. The global risk score is 64.07, still high_risk, 0.83 points above this morning's 11:37Z generation of 63.24 and 1.05 points above the 2026-11-03 close of 63.02. This move is the tape itself rather than a vintage catch-up, and it is rotation rather than a selloff: SPY is up 1.8625 percent while semiconductors fall 3.571 percent, memory 7.5203 percent and data centres 7.5359 percent; MU is down 6.8109 percent and NVDA 2.1869 percent, while AMD, reported 6 percent higher before the open, sits at 0.1498 percent. Both tails of breadth opened at once: 47 of 157 names printed a 63 session low against 12 this morning, and 10 printed a 63 session high against 1 this morning. The regime is indeterminate for a 2nd consecutive session with no evidence recorded, because no rung of the ladder fires: VIX at 20.83 is under 28, breadth at 0.3871 is above 0.35, high yield OAS at 3.40 is under 5.0, the curve at 0.32 is positive, cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 is under 0.55, and momentum is 0.0208 percent below zero. Credit sits on the other side: high yield OAS tightened to 3.40 from 3.43, investment grade to 0.93 from 0.94, and bitcoin at 80259 is up 3.28225 percent over 24 hours. The stress is inside AI hardware rather than across the market: SPY is 1.3721 percent off its 52 week high and 5.2717 percent above its 200 day average.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 is the largest single contribution at 7.5 points, from 4 of 8 scoring legs: the dollar index at 121.6656 above 105, the real rate at 2.62 above 1.5 and small caps 4.7604 points behind over 63 sessions are all standing levels, and those 3 never move with the tape. Only the gold leg does, so the dimension held at 0.50.

Liquidity and credit at 77.46 is still the highest dimension: high yield OAS at 3.40 sits at the 86.5 percentile and contributes 6.92 points, investment grade is 0.93, and the overnight reverse repo fell to 0.225 from 0.427, which the neutral deviation mapping reads as the facility running dry. This leg added 0.038 to the score today.

Equity structure rose to 70.94 and is the largest source of tonight's increase at 0.812 points: the 63 session new low share is 0.2994, 47 of 157 names, the new high share is 0.0637, 10 of 157, and semis relative strength is 15.7767 points behind over 63 sessions. Highs and lows expanding together is rotation, not a broad selloff.

Volatility rose to 49.05 in the counter-intuitive direction: VIX fell from 21.15 to 20.83, scoring 71.9, but SPY 20 day realized volatility rose to 13.2356 and lifted the dimension by 0.480 points on its own. The implied side is not pricing this selloff; the realized side is catching up.

Macro at 74.06 still hangs on the 2026-11-02 rate vintage: the real 10 year at 2.62 sits at the 97.67 percentile and contributes 4.8835 points, the nominal 10 year at 4.91 at 96.87 contributes 4.687, and the curve is 0.32. That is 2 sessions behind tonight's tape, and the dimension did not move today.

supporting_signals.claim: AI hardware is the only damaged block tonight: semiconductors 3.571 percent, semiconductor equipment 6.2432 percent, data centres 7.5359 percent and memory 7.5203 percent all fell, and 3 of those 4 are the 3 worst rows of the 22.

The 4 scoring semis names diverge more clearly than the index: MU 6.8109 percent, NVDA 2.1869 percent and AVGO 1.8878 percent fell while AMD rose 0.1498 percent, and the 2.684 percent sector row is their equal weight mean.

The memory theme at 7.5203 percent is priced by 6 US constituents only: both Korean legs still have their last bar on 2026-11-03 and 5 of the 13 members are A-shares excluded by design, so the row is not a full basket reading.
Semis relative strength is 15.7767 points behind over 63 sessions, wider than this morning's 10.3741, and that is the cleanest single measure of the AI hardware de-rating.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit did not follow the equity move: high yield OAS tightened to 3.40 from 3.43 and investment grade to 0.93 from 0.94, so the AI hardware selloff has not reached financing costs.

At the index level it is close to the opposite story: SPY is 1.3721 percent off its 52 week high, 5.2717 percent above its 200 day average, and 63 session momentum is only 0.0208 percent below zero, which is why the trend dimension subtracted 0.503 points.
Implied volatility went the other way: VIX fell from 21.15 to 20.83, so the options market treated neither this selloff nor the 2026-11-06 employment report as a systemic event.

12 of the 22 rows rose, led by consumer electronics 4.6103 percent, gaming 4.192 percent, digital advertising 3.824 percent, fintech 2.7186 percent and internet platforms 2.7142 percent: money rotated inside the market rather than leaving it.

what_changed_today: Every file is stamped 20:37Z, which is 15:37 ET and 23 minutes before the 16:00 close, so the US prices are a session snapshot rather than official closing prints, and the last hour can still rewrite them.

The 0.83 point gain is entirely today's tape: equity structure adds 0.812, volatility 0.480, liquidity and credit 0.038, and trend subtracts 0.503, while macro and cross-asset are unchanged; the 4 legs sum to 0.83.
Both tails of breadth opened at once: 63 session new lows rose from 12 to 47 of 157 names, new highs from 1 to 10, and the share above the 200 day average from 0.3742 to 0.3871.

The pre-market call reversed: a 10:20Z headline had memory names higher and AMD up 6 percent before the open, but AMD sits at 0.1498 percent while memory prints 7.5203 percent and data centres 7.5359 percent.

The A-share block fell back a session: all 11 bars for 2026-11-04 carry prices and volume but a null close, so this layer republishes the 2026-11-03 session, mean 7.5377 percent lower, overwriting the correct 2026-11-04 session, mean 10.6763 percent higher, that the 12:38Z brief published this morning.
The regime sits at indeterminate for a 2nd consecutive session with an empty regime_evidence while the score stays high_risk, because no rung of the ladder fires.
watch_next: The official closes arrive with the next refresh: 23 minutes separate the 15:37 snapshot from the 16:00 bell, and the late tape can reorder tonight's small cap and semiconductor prints.
Breadth at 0.3871 is only 0.0371 above the 0.35 risk_off gate and VIX at 20.83 is 7.17 below 28, so one more session like this re-labels the regime risk_off outright.

Whether AI hardware stops bleeding: semis relative strength is already 15.7767 points behind, and if the de-rating spreads to networking at 3.1127 percent and industrial automation at 2.1535 percent, the 12 rising rows of 22 will start thinning.
Employment Situation on 2026-11-06 and CPI on 2026-11-10 are the next high importance prints, and the real 10 year at 2.62 in the 97.67 percentile keeps the rate channel the dominant macro risk.

The A-share block needs a source fix, not a re-run: the null closes on all 11 names are a provider side defect, and until it is fixed every post-close run will keep overwriting the correct closes the morning brief published.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth holds 0.40 and AI hardware stabilises
points: Breadth climbs from 0.3871 through 0.40, the 63 session new high share expands past 0.0637 and the new low share falls back from 0.2994, releasing the heaviest leg inside equity structure.
Semis relative strength stops widening from 15.7767 points behind and high yield OAS holds at 3.40 or tighter, taking credit out of the story entirely.
VIX falls under 20 from 20.83 and realized volatility falls back from 13.2356, returning the 0.480 points volatility contributed tonight.

base_case.title: Base case: the rotation runs on and 64.07 holds
points: Equity structure and trend keep offsetting each other, the score oscillates within a point of 64.07, the index stays near its 52 week high and AI hardware keeps de-rating.
The regime stays indeterminate: VIX 20.83, high yield OAS 3.40, the curve at 0.32, cross-asset at 0.50 and momentum 0.0208 percent below zero all remain inside their bands.
Vintages catch up: rates still sit on 2026-11-02 and FX on 2026-10-30, so macro can move without any new tape at all.

bear_case.title: Bear case: breadth breaks 0.35 and the regime turns risk_off
points: One more session like this takes breadth from 0.3871 through 0.35, and that single ladder rule is enough to relabel the regime risk_off.
Semis relative strength widens past 15.7767 points behind and the 47 new lows expand further, pushing equity structure up from 70.94.

High yield OAS moves off 3.40 toward the 5.0 liquidity gate while the 10 year at 4.91 and the real 10 year at 2.62 stay pinned near their percentiles, so the credit cushion disappears at the same time.
